handback.t:
**Findings.** Both are addressed in code, but the fix breaks `/ruflo swarm topology` (see regression check). Verdict: findings open until that is resolved.

**Finding 1: ADDRESSED.**
- Evidence: `state.ts:88-102` adds the `RETIRED_NAMES` table. `state.ts:107-110` makes `viewOf` lowercase and whitespace-normalise its input, then fall back to `RETIRED_NAMES`.
- `commands.ts:39-42` makes `parseRuflo` try the full multi-word text before the verb switch.
- Run result: `parseRuflo('learning lab')` returns `{open, neural}`.
- Coverage is complete: learning lab, memory lab, claims board, plugins & mods, plugins and mods, plus the other retired menu names.
- `tests/group-scheme.spec.ts` passes, 15 of 15.

**Finding 2: ADDRESSED.** `help-topics-core.ts:76` now says "l neural lab". The new spec check at `group-scheme.spec.ts:~138` uses `/\b(learning lab|memory lab|claims board|plugins & mods|swarm topology)\b/i`, which is case-insensitive with word boundaries and catches the old text. The source-wide "retired name" test now uses a `(?<![\w-])name(?![\w-])` regex with the `i` flag. It exempts only the one-line `'x': 'y',` alias entries, plus the `menu-aliases` file.

**parseRuflo regression check.** I read the whole function. I ran it for the cases below; the output is real except `/ruflo swarm` and `/ruflo room`, noted at the end. The new check only fires when there is more than one word. Every bare single-word command and bare `/ruflo` is therefore untouched by construction.

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `mission` | unchanged: run `mission-status` |
| `catalog` | unchanged: commands |
| `agent a1` | unchanged: agent `a1` |
| `timeline 5m` | unchanged: timeline with args |
| `events level` | unchanged: events with args |
| `filter swarm` | unchanged: filter |
| `swarm claims` | unchanged: delegate to ruflo-swarm |
| `run spawn-coder` | unchanged: run |
| `yes` | unchanged: confirm |
| `ask q` | unchanged: run `ask` |
| `help` | unchanged: help |
| bare `/ruflo` | unchanged: open with no view |
| `swarm` | unchanged: no second word, so the new check is skipped (not run directly) |
| `room` | unchanged: no second word, so the new check is skipped (not run directly) |
| **`swarm topology`** | **CHANGED** |
| **`agent timeline`** | **CHANGED** |

- **`swarm topology`: not acceptable.** It used to return `{delegate, ruflo-swarm, 'topology'}` because `topology` is in `SWARM_SUBS`. It now returns `{open, swarm}`. The alias `'swarm topology': 'swarm'` collides with a documented subcommand (HELP line 146: `/ruflo swarm pane|status|topology|claims|consensus`).
  - Where it bites: `tests/palette.test.ts:243` expects `'beneath answered: swarm topology'`. It will now get `'ruflo console: Swarm'`.
  - I could not run that test here, because `claude-code/testing` does not resolve in this checkout. The conclusion rests on the parse output above plus reading the test.
  - Fix: remove the `'swarm topology'` entry from `RETIRED_NAMES`. The spec's `ALIASES` table (`group-scheme.spec.ts:121`) and the key-help regex (`group-scheme.spec.ts:138`) both mention it and need updating. Or make the verb switch win over aliases whose first word is a verb.
- **`agent timeline`: acceptable but worth knowing.** It used to drill into an agent named "timeline". It now opens the Timeline page. That is plausibly what a user means by that phrase, and an agent literally named "timeline" is unlikely. I would keep it, or drop it to be safe.
- The only other first-word verbs among the aliases and multi-word labels are `agent`, `swarm`, `mods`, `events`, `timeline`, and `mission`. Only `swarm topology` and `agent timeline` collide.
- Other multi-word names do not collide with a verb: learning lab, memory lab, claims board, plugins & mods, event stream, cost & budget, the room, ai terminal, x.ruv.io board, main menu, dev tools, neural lab, vector lab, plugin catalog, security & doctor, what's new. They also start with no verb, since `events` is a verb but `event stream` is not.

**New breakage in the fix diff.**
- **Important:** `commands.ts:39-42` together with `state.ts:99` breaks `/ruflo swarm topology`. It no longer delegates to ruflo-swarm and instead opens the Swarm page. This likely fails `tests/palette.test.ts:243` and the HELP-documented subcommand.

**Out-of-scope observations.**
- `tests/palette.test.ts` cannot run in this environment (`claude-code/testing` is unresolved), so the swarm regression is not caught locally.
- `swarm topology` is also listed in the key-help retired-names regex, which would now be a stale pairing if the alias is removed.

**Verdict: findings open.** Findings 1 and 2 are addressed in code, but the fix introduces the `swarm topology` regression above and must be corrected before approval.
